query:
SELECT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM bear_work_runs sibling
             WHERE sibling.job_id = $1
               AND sibling.id <> $2
               AND sibling.state IN ('claimed', 'provisioning', 'running', 'reporting')
               AND (sibling.queued_at < $3
                    OR (sibling.queued_at = $3 AND sibling.id < $2))
         ) AS "exists!"
